Enter a corner, tap Space, then steer into it. Once the rear steps out, steer the opposite way to balance the drift. Hold a controlled drift through a corner to fill the charge meter, then tap Space again to regain grip and trigger an exit boost. Staying on the road and balancing the slide earns charge. Spinning out or leaving the road loses it.
